method: For each SDTM rule, the defect in `planted` was written into one record of the seed-301 export, CORE was run, and its findings were compared with the unchanged export's. `same-defect`: the CORE rules listed report the planted defect. `related`: they report a consequence of it but not the defect itself. `none`: CORE raised nothing for it.
